name: Cunning Weapons
description: Gain proficiency with diamond weapon set. Gain access to the Tier 0 spell Thwip.

name: Shield Draw
description: You may draw, stow, or switch between weapons and Shields without using your Move action.

name: Combat Adaptation
description: Once per turn, after playing a card for an attack, you may change the weapon used for the attack before determining its final effect.

name: Powerful Strike
description: When you hit with a melee weapon using a face card deal 1 additional damage.

name: Guard Breaker
description: When you hit an enemy with a melee attack, you may can reduce the damage by 1 to reduce the enemies AC by 2 until the beginning of your next turn. This applies to additional attacks on  your turn. This effect cannot stack.

name: Riposte
description: As a reaction, when an enemy misses you with a melee attack, you may burn the top card of your deck to make an immediate melee attack against that enemy.

name: Quick Fighter
description: Once per short rest, when you play a card for a melee attack, you may immediately draw one card after the attack resolves.

name: Dual Resonance
description: Choose two suits. When making a might attack, those two suits can now add resonance with their associated weapon.

name: Steady Aim
description: If you don't move on your turn, add +1 to your attack.

name: Hunter's Eye
description: Gain proficiency in Perception or Survival. If you already have proficiency, gain expertisein that skill instead.

name: Skirmisher
description: When an enemy gets close to you, you can use your reaction to burn one card and move without provoking any additional side effects.

name: Called Shot
description: When making a ranged attack, you may declare a specific target such as a hand, weapon, leg, or exposed object. On a hit, the GM may apply an appropriate secondary effect instead of the normal weapon mastery effect.

name: Volley
description: Burn a card when making a ranged attack to affect a second nearby target. Use the first cards modifiers to attack a second target.

name: Covering Fire
description: When attacking an enemy that is next to an ally, give your ally +2 AC until your next turn.

name: Hidden Archer
description: Gain proficiency in Stealth or expertise if already proficient.

name: Invisible Archer
description: When attacking from a hidden position, you may burn the top card of your deck to remain hidden.

name: Party Scout
description: During exploration, you may designate yourself as the party's scout. Gain an advantage or other appropriate benefit when detecting ambushes, tracking creatures, or identifying distant threats.

name: Master Archer
description: When making a ranged attack from a hidden position, you may treat the card played as matching the suit of your bow for the purpose of weapon resonance.
